run_command: python solution/main.py doctor --input input --output output && python solution/main.py train --input input --output output && python solution/main.py predict --checkpoint output/checkpoint --input input/validation.jsonl --output output/predictions.npy
notes: Debug variant only (scale=debug_only, reference-large not claimed). train: batch-1 per frame, epochs=1 -> exactly 12 optimizer updates over the 12 VKITTI2 train frames; MAE loss on valid pixels 0.1-80 m with bilinear interpolation of predicted_depth to native GT size; fp32 CUDA, real backward/step with finiteness checks; freeze-backbone flag available. Outputs: output/checkpoint (HF save_pretrained + processor), output/train_state.pt (AdamW state, step, RNG for python/numpy/torch CPU+CUDA), output/predictions.npy (4,126,392) float32 metres, output/predictions_meta.json, output/run.json with cuda-synchronized timings, per-step losses, grad norms, weight-norm delta and coverage. AbsRel/RMSE are computed from held-out labels when present and reported as null with source 'hidden' otherwise; no validation labels are used for training or per-image rescaling. doctor inspects files, manifest sha256, model dir, packages and CUDA without loading weights and returns 78 on any missing item, else 0. All heavy imports are inside subcommands so --help never loads a model.
